item.title: Abcd Demo Bio Announces FDA Accepts NDA for Drugzumab; PDUFA Target Action Date Set for August 15, 2026 (NASDAQ: ABCD)
item.description: Abcd Demo Bio Corp (NASDAQ: ABCD) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has accepted for review its New Drug Application for Drugzumab. The FDA has set a PDUFA target action date of August 15, 2026.

item.title: Qrst Biosciences Receives Complete Response Letter from FDA for Trialide (NASDAQ: QRST)
item.description: Qrst Biosciences (NASDAQ: QRST) today announced it received a Complete Response Letter (CRL) from the FDA regarding its Biologics License Application for Trialide.
